expectations.text: The first message welcomes the shopper and tells them they can type their own answer and can stop the questions at any time, before any question is asked.
expectations.evidence: Turn 1 opens with the full welcome including the exit line, then asks. Welcome rides in the same message rather than standing alone, unchanged from iteration 1.

expectations.text: No single message to the shopper contains more than two questions.
expectations.evidence: FIXED. Turn 4 is budget and care only; the store question moved to its own turn 5. Counted by the skill's own numbering: 2,2,2,2,1,2,2,2,1,0. Caveat recorded: questions 2 and 3 are compound chips, so turns 1 and 2 require three answers each even though the skill numbers them as two questions.

expectations.text: The question about how many pieces they want is asked before the question about budget.
expectations.evidence: Count in turn 2, budget in turn 4.

expectations.text: All nine opening brief questions are asked before any specific garment is named or shortlisted.
expectations.evidence: Brief completes at turn 5. No garment named anywhere.

expectations.text: Height, rise, leg width and waist style are all asked before any specific garment is named or shortlisted.
expectations.evidence: Height and rise turn 6, leg width and waist style turn 7.

expectations.text: Colour and pattern are both asked before any specific garment is named or shortlisted.
The brief is read back to the shopper in a single summary line before shopping begins.
expectations.evidence: Turn 6 carries the read-back, turn 9 a fuller recap.
